title: Sleeping in a Hammock
hook: Your spine bows as you nap.
banner:
YOUR SPINE BOWS
AS YOU NAP
scene: cozy bedroom with a hanging hammock

beats.label: 2 HRS
beats.line: After a couple of hours, your spine aligns, easing pressure points.
beats.idea: Cartoon shows the character's back smoothing, pressure points disappearing.

beats.label: 4 HRS
beats.line: After a few hours, gentle sway stimulates the ear, helping relaxation.
beats.idea: Close‑up of inner ear glowing, brain with melatonin icons.

beats.label: 6 HRS
beats.line: After several hours, leg elevation can aid venous flow, reducing swelling.
beats.idea: Zoom on leg veins with brighter flow, swelling shrinking.

beats.label: 8 HRS
beats.line: After many hours, head elevation may keep the stomach lower, easing reflux.
beats.idea: Stomach illustration with acid arrows blocked, content settled.

beats.label: 12 HRS
beats.line: When you wake, you feel refreshed and your heart rate steadies.
beats.idea: Character rises, heart icon normal, neutral smile.

description: A quick visual tour of the body’s changes when you spend a night in a hammock.

end.line: Would you try it, yes or no?

topic: What happens if you sleep in a hammock?
